rows.en:
Sharivan… The Bell siblings have headed for Earth! To fight Madou.

The Bell siblings hold a grudge against Madou… They went to Earth to take revenge on them!

All I did was tell them Madou is now plotting to invade Earth, and off they rushed…

Anyway, they're a reckless pair, so there's no telling what they'll do. Please, Sharivan! I want you to protect the two of them…

…That's the story!

And since they flew to Earth so openly, Madou, Makuu and Fuuma too must surely know of their movements…

Be very careful!
Yes, sir…
Space Sheriff Sharivan was pursuing the unidentified flying object, heading for the Sea of Trees at the foot of Mt. Fuji, where it had come down.

The unidentified flying object the TDF asked us to investigate is probably that space boat…

It must be the Bell siblings Rita mentioned! I hope they're safe…
About 15 of them…
Easy, easy! Come on, let's send 'em flying!
Billy, let's go!
Yeah!
Whoa…
Billyyy!!
Right, get them!!
Madou won't follow us here. Billy, are you all right?

You took care of them? That's my sis!

Hehehe… It's just a scratch, I'm fine. Madou's not so tough, huh?
Oh, Billy…
You're the Bell siblings, aren't you?
Who are you?
Space Sheriff Sharivan!
A Space Sheriff?
I've heard about you from Rita. That there's a Space Sheriff fighting Madou…
That same Rita sent me a message! Asking me to protect you two…
What a meddling old lady!
Madou is a fearsome enemy! The two of you can't handle them alone.

Hahaha… We just had a fight with them!

They caught me off guard and I messed up, but Madou's nothing special!
What!?
We'll lend you a hand anytime, Mr. Space Sheriff…
Wow, this kid has no fear of death… I can't just leave him be!
We've got no use for Space Sheriffs!

Well, I can't leave it at that! Rita asked me to, after all.

More importantly… why do you hate Madou so much? What on earth is the reason?
That's none of your business!
People can't live all on their own! We trust each other, help each other…
How naive! We don't trust anyone! Trust people and you just get betrayed…
That's right!

That's wrong… The way you think is wrong!

If we can't trust people, we can't fight evil!

The future… belongs to young people like you and me. To protect it from the evil organizations, I won't hold back, even with my life!
Get out of here! We siblings will fight on our own! Right, sis?
Yeah…

I can't just stand by and let you die! Listen! Stay here until I come back!

I'll go find a hideout! Got it?
Can we trust him? That Space Sheriff…
Why do you ask?
He might not be a Space Sheriff at all, right? He could even be… a Madou spy, couldn't he?
Surely not…
You trust him? That guy…
I want to! He had that kind of eyes…
Hmph, ridiculous…
He sold us out! I knew it, he was a spy!
Billy! You can't fight yet in that condition! Leave it to me!
But…
Don't give me a hard time! Listen to your sister… Okay?
Okay. Sis, be careful!
Hahaha… You who defy our Madou! There's no escape now! Eliminate!!
Sis! I'm fighting too, after all!
No, Billy! It's dangerous, Billyyy!!
Uwaaaagh!!

Hahaha…

Got him!! I failed to finish him earlier, but this time I got him! Prepare yourself, here's the finishing blow!!
Billyyy!
I won't forgive you, General Guiler!
…!? Sharivan…
Billy, hang in there! Don't move from this spot! Got it?
Curse you, Sharivan! You mean to interfere? I'll teach you a lesson! Eliminate!!
Underestimating them as a mere girl and boy was my mistake, and a terrible blunder… But next time it won't go like this!!
Nuoooh…
Ugh…
Billy, hang in there!

Hang on, Billy! You'll get better, I'm sure of it…

…!?

What is it?

………

I doubted you, Sharivan. I thought you might be a Madou spy…
What, is that all!?
Sorry… I was wrong!
It's okay…

When I was 10… and my brother was 5, our parents were killed.

While traveling to another planet, they ran into a Madou warship. Madou rained missiles on a passenger ship that carried no weapons, and shot it down…

The person who took us in and raised us was a space warrior…
And so you became space warriors too?

Hoping to take revenge on Madou someday, we wandered from planet to planet, honing our skills.

Days of guerrilla life, fighting from dawn to dusk. Informants, betrayals… and we stopped trusting people.
But I… I trust you, Sharivan! From now on, always…
Fufufu…

I'm glad to hear you say that, Billy… …!?

This is…!?
It's a good-luck charm…
I have one too!
Are you descendants of Planet Iga?

Planet Iga?

I've heard of it from Papa… That Planet Iga was destroyed by Madou, about 2000 years ago…
That's right… I'm a descendant of Planet Iga too!
